thread:
maya: Drafting an ops 'breadcrumbs' runbook for late recomputes on kv-aggregates. Want quick alignment on routing policy + quota bump flow before we run dry-run.
sam: sg — which tenant(s)?
maya: acme-inc primary, also test-alpha. Late ingest spikes; recompute will hit small-window lane and could starve other backfills.
jin: Proposal: temp route tag `breadcrumb-burst` -> send to dedicated low-latency pool. Quota +30% for 1h; autoscale cap at 4 nodes. fallback to 'thin' model when under pressure.
alex: How do we flip this from console? Need a toggle so oncall can change routing without infra PR.
maya: console flag suggestion: `recompute.routing_override=breadcrumbs-v1;expires=1h`. ops-bot playbook to flip and log reason. Dry-run command: `./recomputectl start --tenant acme-inc --mode dryrun --route breadcrumbs-v1`.
ops-bot: Scheduled dry-run queued at 2024-04-16T18:00Z (run id r-20240416-01).
rachel: Observability ask: surface per-route token burn and queue length in the console for the first 30m of a route change. Otherwise ops will be blind.
sam: Also ensure dedupe keys stable — add `shard_key = tenant_id || '|' || day` to prevent double counting during retries.
maya: Quick SQL check I ran: `SELECT tenant_id, SUM(tokens_generated) FROM agg_kv WHERE day='2024-04-15' GROUP BY tenant_id;` -> acme-inc ~2.4M tokens. That informs quota bump.
jin: Edge case: if primary model fails, fallback should be quantized-7b rather than 3b to keep quality — cost tradeoff noted.
alex: I'll add a console modal 'Recompute breadcrumbs' that requires TTL and reason, and wires into ops-bot to record user + rationale. Also add a one-click dry-run button.
maya: Action items: alex -> console toggle + modal; jin -> routing-policy snippet and autoscale caps; rachel -> metrics wiring (per-route tokens + queue); sam -> dedupe key PR. Target: dry-run in ~2h then canary run if green.
sam: :thumbsup:
maya: I'll prep a short runbook note on docs: https://docs.redwood.internal/recompute/breadcrumbs and drop after dry-run.
jin: One more — can we add a temporary telemetry tag so billing shows route consumption separately? makes rollbacks easier.
rachel: Good call. I'll add a per-route tag to the cost pipeline and a dashboard row.
maya: Ok wrapping up here. If no objections by EOD we proceed with scheduled dry-run. Thanks everyone.
